mapper.select: SELECT l.log_id, l.source_id, l.source_name, l.run_status, l.fetched_count, l.inserted_count, l.matched_count, l.error_msg, l.start_time, l.end_time FROM bid_crawl_log l WHERE l.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY l.log_id DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_crawl_log (source_id, source_name, run_status, fetched_count, inserted_count, matched_count, error_msg, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{sourceName}, #{runStatus}, #{fetchedCount}, #{insertedCount}, #{matchedCount}, #{errorMsg}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
